import re
lines = file_content['content'].strip().split('\n')
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artists
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artists_str = song_str.split(' by ', 1)
            # Artists may be comma-separated
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
print(old_songs)
